title: Heart Canisters Recipe Fixer
description: A datapack designed to add missing recipes to the Heart Canisters mod (1.19.4)
body:
Some recipes in the Heart Canisters mod are missing in the 1.19.4 version, this datapack adds those recipes back in

The mod in question: [Heart Canisters](https://modrinth.com/mod/heartcanister)
